title: fix(cron): retain cleanup work after cancellation
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Cancelling a cron run can return before its core finishes cleanup. The host launch owns a detached async-work scope, but the core-and-webhook promise was not retained in that scope. After cancellation released the caller, draining the scope could close it before delayed cleanup registered its next operation.

Retain that promise with the existing `trackAsyncWork` owner. Cancellation still returns through the same `Promise.race`, while the launch retains its unfinished cleanup and delivery tail. Extend the cancellation-attribution regression to start draining the caller scope before releasing the core and require deferred cleanup to resolve. Delivery authority, revocation, watchdog behavior, active-run settlement, and committed-media checks are preserved. The focused two-file source is `f395356fb3fc3952c8521f36f2dd3a879bda3d75` (+31/−12), with no new exports, dependencies, SQL, schema, SDK contract, scope, or handshake.

The changed-file preimages at integration base `432d890350b02c431424c5689270832ddf3a86a3` exactly match the reviewed source parent. The async-work scope is byte-identical across source, review, runtime candidate, and that base; the launch queue and detached admission owner also match the runtime candidate. No adaptation is needed. Preserve main's completion-fixture callback join and exclude temporary diagnostics and unrelated source ancestors.

## Evidence

Focused runtime and the causal control finished on composed candidate `8d087040fefe324e5ff7fa76faf497fadb542c08`:

| Proof | Result | Vitest | Launcher | Complete wrapper |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `pnpm test src/cron/service/timer.timeout-watchdog.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` | 9/9 pass; extended regression 18 ms | 458.43 s | 520.14 s | 557.40 s |
| `pnpm test src/cron/isolated-agent/current-session-completion.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` | 19/19 pass, including all four real occurrence-fence cases | 1485.20 s | 1634.56 s | 1729.14 s |
| Original-product inverse, unchanged watchdog regression selected by `--testNamePattern 'returns cancellation attribution'` | Expected 1 failure, 8 skipped; regression 65 ms | 423.72 s | 509.40 s | 548.39 s |

The inverse removes only the production fix. Its owner bytes match the reviewed source parent and integration base; the test remains the exact reviewed regression. It fails at line 208 because delayed cleanup reaches `AsyncWorkScope.track` after the scope has closed: `Async work scope is closed`. All three wrappers finished on the original exact candidate with clean checkouts, no surviving processes, and no restoration blocks. The completion suite is composed-candidate sibling evidence: its fixture differs from current main only in diagnostic assertion context, so this does not claim an exact current-main test-file run. Earlier [V10 CI evidence](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38281839713/job/114921075562) also passed watchdog 9/9 (4.123 s summed case time) and completion 19/19 (79.444 s summed case time).

One isolated Codex review completed with no actionable findings. Both changed blobs are identical in [V17 static-qualified CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38292637049): build, production types, cron test-type stripe 5, type-aware lint stripe 1, source contracts, Knip exports, architecture/Madge, and worker/dialect ratchets passed. These are retained exact-head job results, not a standalone landing-head `check:changed` invocation or aggregate green run. Final landing-head overlap and remote outcome verification belong to the integration owner.

A published-driver cell is not required for this cron execution-cleanup change. The [V17 published-driver update cell](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38292637049/job/114965277486) nevertheless executed and passed from published 2026.10.2 to the candidate, including checksum, update completion, readiness 200, and running-version verification. No numerical SQL/request or T1 improvement is claimed.

## Final publication validation

Exact PR CI [run 38311167255](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38311167255) completed successfully: 9/9 cases passed (42.74 s Vitest, 44.37 s wrapper); selected types, lint, contracts and ratchets passed, and Madge executed with zero cycles. The broader [Knip scan](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38311910220/job/115019807997) contains byte-identical changed files and reports only three unrelated Team-scale exports, independently removed on main by `36e78f215f1f058af15919da8a60c06797a759e8`. Current main `655d57552159ef3e155e54cd3b009657009f54dc` has no overlapping changed-file delta. This completes the applicable publication checks without claiming the broader candidate or scheduled main is green.
